说明 README: 老师改这个文件就能更新每周内容。weekly = 每周一帖（start 是上线日期，到这一天才会出现）；challenges = 真实挑战；classBest = 本周最佳评论（不用就写 null）；submitUrl = 学生交截图的问卷链接（不用就留空）。最下面的 _template 是空白模板，复制一份放进 weekly 里再填。

weekly.src: 铁蛋「我的新形象有没有很惊艳」评论区
weekly.src_en: From the comments on Tyler's video
weekly.text: 为啥染了黑头发显得更年轻了呢[表情]
weekly.en: How come dyeing his hair black makes him look younger? [sticker]

q.zh: 这位网友觉得铁蛋染了黑头发以后怎么样？
q.en: What does this user think of Tyler after he dyed his hair black?

task.zh: 学这位网友，用「为啥……呢」给铁蛋写一条评论，问一个你好奇的问题。
task.en: Like this user, write a comment to Tyler with 「为啥……呢」, asking something you are curious about.
task.hint: 为啥你的孩子一眼就认出你了呢？

weekly.src: 铁蛋「我的新形象有没有很惊艳」评论区
weekly.src_en: From the comments on Tyler's video
weekly.text: 铁蛋还是黑头发显得你高级，有点像费翔[表情]
weekly.en: Tyler, black hair really makes you look classy — you look a bit like Fei Xiang [emoji]

q.zh: 这位网友觉得铁蛋像谁？
q.en: Who does this user think Tyler looks like?

task.zh: 用「有点像……」写一条评论：你觉得染发以后的铁蛋像谁？
task.en: Write a comment with 「有点像……」: who do you think Tyler looks like with dyed hair?
task.hint: 铁蛋染了头发以后有点像……

challenges.zh: 在小红书上关注一位中国博主，看完他最新的一条笔记。
challenges.en: Follow a Chinese creator on Xiaohongshu and read their latest note.

challenges.zh: 给一条你喜欢的笔记点赞、收藏，再留一条中文评论。
challenges.en: Like and save a note you enjoy, then leave a comment in Chinese.

challenges.zh: 在小红书搜「挑战」，找一条挑战类视频，说说它有哪几个阶段。
challenges.en: Search 「挑战」 on Xiaohongshu, find a challenge video and name its stages.

challenges.zh: 在一条真实的笔记下面，用「挺……的」或「更……了」写一条评论。
challenges.en: Under a real note, write a comment using 「挺……的」 or 「更……了」.

videos.title: 示例：这里写视频标题
videos.creator: 博主名字
videos.intro: 一句话介绍这条视频：谁、挑战什么。
videos.intro_en: One line about the video: who, and what the challenge is.

lines.zh: 今天我挑战一天只说中文。
lines.en: Today I'm challenging myself to speak only Chinese for a day.

lines.zh: 你们觉得我能坚持到晚上吗？
lines.en: Do you think I can last until tonight?

patterns.note: 用问题结尾，邀请观众评论。
patterns.note_en: End with a question to invite comments.
patterns.ex: 你们觉得我能坚持到晚上吗？
patterns.ex_en: Do you think I can last until tonight?

opts: Speak only Chinese for a day
questions.why: 开头就说清楚了挑战是什么，这是「挑战设定」。
questions.why_en: He states the challenge at the start: that's the Challenge stage.

questions.zh: 和铁蛋的视频比，哪里不一样？
questions.en: How is it different from Tyler's video?
opts: 没有「引出话题」，直接开始挑战
No premise; it starts with the challenge
questions.why: 阶段可以省略：这条视频直接从挑战开始。
questions.why_en: Stages can be skipped: this one starts right at the challenge.

videos.think: 看的时候想一想：这条视频有哪几步？和精讲视频相比，少了哪一步、多了哪一步？
videos.think_en: While you watch, think: what steps does this video have? Compared with the in-depth video, which step is missing, and which is added?

questions.zh: 这条视频挑战的是什么？

questions.why_en: It tests whether the creator can handle the food. Food is the most common kind of challenge.
